description: The failure that is not an oversight. systemd-journald.service writes NoNewPrivileges=no with a comment saying why, which is a decision somebody made rather than a default nobody changed — and journald is not exempt, so it fails. cron.service writes the same value beside it and is exempt, which is what makes this fixture prove the two are handled differently: one is a finding and the other is a documented reason the setting would break the service.
